integrity: The proof uses the primary source's exact modal refinement, localization, inclusion, identity, transitivity, seriality, and confluence conditions. On the equality preorder with identity local covers, the first two conditions become automatic. The remaining conditions yield the stated pointwise normal forms; finite confluence gives a least modal cover for CK-box. The primary PDF was inspected at the CM modal-cover definition, the SL and PLL conditions, and the CK-box seriality/confluence section. Finite exhaustive replay independently verifies all local classifications through the stated sizes.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for the finite discrete local cover base and identifies modal covering relations only up to equality of the induced modal operator. Nontrivial refinement or local-cover structure is outside scope. The CK-box least-cover argument uses finiteness, and no satisfiability or proof-search complexity bound is claimed.
title: Exact finite discrete-base normal forms for modal cover semantics
